06 / FAQ

Good to know

Can I renovate one room at a time?

Yes. We can plan the work in phases so you can prioritize the rooms and manage disruption.

How do you prepare a project quote?

We begin with a site visit, discuss priorities, and then share a written scope and estimate for review.

Do you take on repair work?

Yes. We handle selected repairs and restoration work after assessing the condition and the best approach.
